description: Returns projected fantasy points for every player in an NFL week (1-18), in PPR, half-PPR or standard scoring, optionally for one position or team. Use it for start/sit, rankings and "top N at a position this week". Each row also has gridiron_projection, GridIron Data's own model (with model_version and as_of; null when none), which unlike projected_points may be displayed under Pro + Commercial. Players who can't play project 0 with available=false. Free plan: the current week of the current season; other weeks and seasons need Basic; Pro adds projected_stats per row (pass_yds, rec, rush_yds, ...).

gridiron_only.description: true = only GridIron Data's own model projections (gridiron_projection).
gridiron_only.title: Gridiron Only

scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.
scoring.title: Scoring

season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.
season.title: Season

team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.
team.title: Team

weekly_only.description: true = only real weekly projections, without the season-prorated fallback used for weeks not yet published.
weekly_only.title: Weekly Only

name: get_projections

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

gridiron_projections.description: The week's GridIron projection run (model_version, as_of), or null.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

projected_stats.description: Below Pro only: a note that per-stat projections need Pro.

projections.description: One row per player: projected_points, player_id, team, injury status, available, gridiron_projection, and projected_stats on Pro.

prorated_count.description: Rows that use the season-prorated fallback.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

source.description: Present when only GridIron's own projections were asked for.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

unavailable_count.description: Players who can't play (OUT, IR, bye) and project 0.

title: Weekly fantasy projections
